$comment: pi sandbox extension allowlist. Fail-closed: the launcher refuses to run a profile whose entries are missing pins, whose hashes mismatch, or that does not validate against allowlist.schema.json. See packaging/pi/sandbox/README.md.

unattended-exec.description: Unattended execution child: may read, edit, and drive the anvil state loop. Extensions must be hash-pinned; anvil-pi (M2) lands here as a sha256-pinned entry once published.

read-only-review.description: Fresh-context review child: read-only tools, no network, no write surface.
